breadcrumbs.name: Retail & Apparel RFID Solutions — Source Tagging, Inventory Accuracy & Loss Prevention

summary: Item-level RFID tagging is now mandatory for suppliers to Walmart, Target, Macy's and other major retailers. Proud Tek manufactures the full range of UHF RFID tags for garment source tagging, retail inventory and loss prevention — from hang tags and woven care labels to hard tags and paper labels.
